title: Fee bump before Protocol 25: G fee source, muxed inner source, inner fee_charged 100 (not zero)
why: Before Protocol 25 the inner result of a fee bump reports a non-zero fee_charged (100 here) beside the outer 200 that the fee source actually paid, and the inner source is a muxed M account. Readers that add the two fees, charge the inner source, or key the source by its M form report wrong fees and accounts.

values.note: The fee source is a G account, not muxed.
The inner source is muxed: GA5ZPIVP… with ID 21449687443220.

notes: Apply index 102 of 170; envelope phase 0 txs[0]. The fee source GCUCLPMV… is a plain G account and also the operation source of the arbitrage path payment (native → VELO → AMM → BTC → yBTC → native through four pools and one offer). The inner source is MA5ZPIVP… = GA5ZPIVP… with muxed ID 21449687443220; only its sequence number changes. Movements are not exact: the payment's ten hops are not the point of the entry. Compare cap-0015/fee-bump-soroban-inner-fee-zero-from-p25, where the inner fee is 0. The lake object was written by stellar-core 23.0.1 long after the ledger closed (source.regenerated true), so its TransactionMeta is v4 with backfilled classic and fee events, not what a node emitted at the time.
